## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to model a cost-benefit for a privacy-preserving, offline-capable feature that touches analytics, data minimization, and rollout planning.

## Key Concepts

- On-device data collection and aggregation


- How would batch sizing change with 5x daily active users?
- What metrics would you monitor to validate uplift and privacy compliance?

## Why This Is Asked

This question tests the ability to design a realistic 18-month cost-benefit analysis (CBA) for an edge ML feature that must balance privacy, compute, and network costs under real-world operational constraints.

## Key Concepts

- **Edge ML with on-device inference**: Running models locally to reduce latency and preserve privacy
- **Privacy budgets and compliance costs**: Managing differential privacy parameters and audit requirements
- **OTA/update bandwidth planning**: Estimating network costs for model and policy updates
- **Drift detection and validation**: Monitoring model performance and detecting distribution shifts
- **ROI and break-even analysis**: Calculating when benefits outweigh operational costs

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudocode for break-even horizon
function breakeven(uplift, perDeviceCost, devices) {
  return (perDeviceCost * devices) / uplift;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you size embeddings and prioritize which items to recommend given memory constraints?

## Why This Is Asked

This question evaluates the ability to reason holistically about on-device ML trade-offs in an enterprise context, balancing privacy requirements, technical constraints, regulatory compliance, and business economics.

- **On-device ML constraints**: Model quantization, memory footprint, and CPU energy consumption
- **Latency requirements**: Differentiating live (real-time) vs. post-call summarization latency targets
- **Local telemetry and storage**: Privacy implications of on-device data handling
- **Multilingual support**: Model management and memory trade-offs across languages
- **Cloud feedback vs. offline updates**: Security and privacy considerations for optional cloud connectivity
- **Regulatory compliance**: GDPR, CCPA, and associated implementation costs
- **Business case development**: Rollout planning, go/no-go criteria, and break-even analysis
